To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the best feature extraction method depends on the representation of the character, the application and the training data.
the best feature extraction method for the given task can be identified by a careful analysis and evaluation of the available methods.

the feature extraction method should be selected based on the type of representation (binary or gray level), the invariance requirements, and the expected variability and distortions of the characters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of feature extraction methods and their evaluation for character recognition systems.
the problem of finding an optimal set of features for a given application.
the development of new methods and the application of these methods to the recognition of characters in documents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single best feature extraction method for all types of characters.
the best method for a given character recognition problem is the method that gives the best recognition results in the given application.
no feature extraction method is superior to any other in all situations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the choice of a feature extraction is a very important factor to achieve good performance in character recognition.
the choice of feature extraction method is a crucial step in the design of a recognition system and that there does not exist a single best method.
there does not exist a universal feature extraction method for off line recognition that performs well for all types of characters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the feature extraction methods are highly application specific.
feature extraction methods should be evaluated in terms of the performance of the character recognition system.
there is no one best feature extraction method that can be used in every application.
